node.statement: Expanding U_ab^dagger tensor U_ab gives sum_{k,l} omega^(b(l-k)) E_{k,k+a} tensor E_{l+a,l}; since sum_{b=0}^{d-1}omega^(b(l-k)) is d if l=k modulo d and 0 otherwise, averaging over a,b gives (1/d)sum_{a,k}E_{k,k+a} tensor E_{k+a,k}=(1/d)sum_{i,j}E_ij tensor E_ji.
